subject: AWS Marketplace entitlement mapping, contract signoff & certification runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Meyer <susan.meyer@acme-analytics.com>, Ben Atwood <ben.atwood@aws-partner.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace — entitlement mapping & signoff plan

Hi Susan / Ben,

Thanks for the time last week. Following up with a concrete plan to get Acme live on AWS Marketplace:

1) Contract finalization — we expect Acme procurement to sign the SOW + SaaS Addendum (attached draft). Can you confirm the final billing contact?
2) Entitlement mapping — we need to map Acme SKUs to AWS entitlements (see attached entitlement-mapping-draft.csv).
3) Metering & certification run — coordinate a short cert window where we send synthetic usage records to AWS and validate consumption/tokens.
4) Go/no-go checklist — we'll run a 3-step checklist and signoff by both sides.

I've attached the SOW draft and a starter mapping file. Karthik / Priyom — can you review the mapping and confirm any changes to the usage dimensions (instances vs. seats) by EOD tomorrow?

Next step: Susan, if procurement can confirm the billing contact and a preferred signature method (DocuSign or email-attach), we'll route the SOW. Also suggest a 30-minute joint call on Monday to review the cert checklist.

Thanks,

--
Jordan Blake
Sr. Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_AWS_Marketplace_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), entitlement-mapping-draft.csv (CSV)

From: Susan Meyer <susan.meyer@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace — entitlement mapping & signoff plan

Jordan — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@acme-analytics.com (CC'd). They prefer DocuSign for SOWs.
- Billing contact: Carla Nguyen (carla.nguyen@acme-analytics.com) — she'll handle invoicing once the entitlement mapping is locked.
- For entitlements: Acme wants per-seat usage (concurrent users) with a small overage bucket. The CSV you sent looks close; I'll loop in our platform engineer on mapping edge cases.

We can do the certification run next Thursday PST. Can you reserve a slot and confirm the checklist items?

Best,
Susan
VP, Strategic Ops
Acme Analytics

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace — entitlement mapping & signoff plan

Jordan / team,

Quick technical review of the attached mapping:

- We should avoid coupling entitlements to IP addresses; suggest mapping to tenant-id + seat_count metric.
- For concurrency, implement a tokenized seat counter (integer per-minute aggregation). AWS usage records will accept integer quantity fields — we'll send aggregated deltas.
- Overage policy: create a separate entitlement labelled "overage-bucket" to track burst consumption and bill monthly.

Action items for this week (internal):
- Priyom: produce a small test harness that posts usage records to the AWS metering API (STAGING).
- Soojin: confirm SOW language around data retention and indemnity; small redline to the SOW PDF is coming.
- Jordan: schedule the certification run (Thurs 24th suggested by Acme).

I'll attach a minimal sample of the usage-record payload in a follow-up.

-Karthik
Lead, Inference Integrations
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace — entitlement mapping & signoff plan

Adding the test harness plan and a stub payload here so Acme and AWS have something to validate during the cert run.

Sample usage-record (STAGING POST):
{
  "product_code": "RWD-AWS-ENT-34521",
  "dimension": "concurrent_seat_minutes",
  "quantity": 120,
  "timestamp": "2027-06-24T16:00:00Z",
  "customer_identifier": "acme-tenant-987",
  "meta": {"run_id":"cert-20270624"}
}

Notes:
- We'll batch minute-level deltas into hourly aggregates for the first two weeks to limit API call volume.
- We'll include an identifier header X-Redwood-Test-Run for easy filtering in AWS logs.

Soojin — thanks for taking the SOW redline. I've attached an initial CSV that maps tenant ids to entitlement names.

-Priyom
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Certification slot confirmed + SOW next steps

Susan / Ben / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Final plan:

- Certification run: Thu, 24 Jun 2027, 09:00–11:00 PT (joint runroom: Zoom link will be sent).
- DocuSign SOW: sent to procurement@acme-analytics.com and Carla Nguyen for signature. Expect countersign by EOD Tue, 22 Jun.
- Technical checklist items attached (aws-usage-cert-checklist.xlsx). Priyom will be the run lead and will post the X-Redwood-Test-Run headers so AWS can filter.
- Post-run: we'll generate an entitlement reconciliation report and a 2-week usage sampling to validate billing curves.

Susan — please confirm Carla received the DocuSign envelope and that procurement is OK with the per-seat + overage arrangement.

Looking forward — small reminder: SoX/retention clause redline included in SOW; legal has approved the wording.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Head of Integrations Programs
Redwood Inference
